# Assignment Description

Determine which Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) on the West Coast of the U.S. are best suited to developing marine aquaculture for several species of oysters and a species of your choice.

Creating a function with the following: 

- **arguments**
    * min and max sea surface temp
    * min and max depth
    * species name
- **species name**
    *outputs:
    * map of EEZ colored by the amount of suitable areas

**Oysters** 
    * sea surface temperature: 11-30°C
    * depth: 0-70 meters below sea level
**CHOOSE MY SPECIES**

- get sea surface temp
-get depth


## Data Preparations
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(tmap) 
library(janitor) 
library(terra)
library(geodata)
```

```{r}
# Read in data
set_file <- c(
    here('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif'),
    here('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif'),
    here('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif'),
    here('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif'),
    here('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')
)

sst_data <- rast(set_file)
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')
eez_data <- st_read('data/wc_regions_clean.shp')
```

## Data Process
```{r}
# Check CRS match for all
st_crs(sst_data) == st_crs(depth)
st_crs(sst_data) == st_crs(eez_data)
st_crs(eez_data) == st_crs(depth)
```

```{r}
# Calculate average SST from 2008-2012
sst_mean <- mean(sst_data, na.rm = TRUE)
# Convert Kelvin to Celsius
sst_cel <- sst_mean - 273.15
# Crop data to match
crop_depth <- crop(depth, sst_cel)
```

```{r}
# Transfer sst ata using bilear method to match
resampled_match <- resample(crop_depth, sst_cel, method = "bilinear")

# Vverify matching of resoultion, origins, and extents for sst data and resampled
cat("After resampling:\n")
cat("Resolutions match:", all(res(resampled_match) == res(sst_cel)), "\n")
cat("Origins match:    ", all(round(origin(resampled_match), 8) == round(origin(sst_cel), 8)), "\n")
cat("Extents match:    ", ext(resampled_match) == ext(sst_cel), "\n")
```
